author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
quote: Patience to faith is like the head to the body. The person who has no patience has not faith.

author: Hamad Bin Isa Al Khalifa
quote: If You Like Your Brother And He'S Prospering, You'Ll Be Pleased For Him.

author: Rumi
quote: Our greatest strength lies in the gentleness and tenderness of our heart.
